annotations.text:
Clickable. Library / Dictionary / New article all navigate, and article rows open the reader.

In the reader: drag the 難易度 slider to change how many words are marked — that is the frequency threshold. Hover a dashed word for its senses. Click the blue phrase (standing in for a text selection) to open Q&A; note the hover cards stop firing while it is open.

Changed from the first version:

· Q&A moved from a per-sentence ? button to text selection
· The Q&A rail is gone — the card sits by the selection
· Word cards show all senses, not one line
· Difficulty slider added
· Grammar column reads zero everywhere
· JMdict attribution on the Dictionary page

Still open:

· Which Ollama model beyond qwen3.8:27b
· Whether the reader must work when the model host is unreachable
· JMnedict, once we can count how many unmatched words are names

The mobile board shows the OS Copy/Look-Up menu deliberately — it will appear over our card and cannot be suppressed without reimplementing selection.
